location.basis: Wikidata coordinates for Chanhu-daro (Q1062208: 26.17361 N, 68.32306 E) fall on the eroded mounds east of a modern walled compound with a circular building, between canals and fields; the coordinates are those of the mounds' centre in Esri World Imagery.

sources.citation_or_service: Esri World Imagery tile service, https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/World_Imagery/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}; Source: Esri, Vantor, Earthstar Geographics, and the GIS User Community
sources.north_label_text: Web Mercator grid north (true north at every point; north up)

main_system_reason: No Harappan line could be identified in the imagery.
notes: The mounds are eroded and scrub-covered, with tracks and a few pits; no wall, street or platform edge is visible. The straight lines in the area are canals, roads, field boundaries and the walls of the modern compound to the west, all excluded.

diagnostics.method: see METHOD.md; deviation peaks from magnitude-weighted gradient-direction histograms folded modulo 90 degrees
